scope.honest_scope: Targeted directly inspected ROOT0 records plus bounded GitHub code search and indexed 0root.ai site; scheduled iterative corpus-wide census code committed but not yet observed running.

limitations: Github default branches and raw content are sampled at different times; no pinned repository commit snapshot yet.
Oversized or non-text files excluded and explicitly counted.
Public site robots can prohibit or block access; blocked pages are reported, never inferred.
All matches are literal words/phrases and are not assertions of distinctive originality.
Private repositories, discussion artifacts, historic revisions, and unlisted pages are outside the current crawl.
No successful Actions run had been independently confirmed at file creation time.
